00232 static inline void timeToTimecodeString (char* string, const int size, const double seconds)
00233 {
00234     const double absSecs = fabs (seconds);
00235     const char* const sign = (seconds < 0) ? "-" : "";
00236     
00237     const int hours = (int) (absSecs / (60.0 * 60.0));
00238     const int mins  = ((int) (absSecs / 60.0)) % 60;
00239     const int secs  = ((int) absSecs) % 60;
00240     const int ms =  ((int)(absSecs * 1000 + 0.5)) % 1000;
00241     
00242     if(hours == 0)
00243     {
00244         if(mins == 0)
00245         {
00246             snprintf(string, size, "%s%01d.%03d", sign, secs, ms);
00247         }
00248         else
00249         {
00250             snprintf(string, size, "%s%01d:%02d.%03d", sign, mins, secs, ms);
00251         }
00252     }
00253     else
00254     {
00255         snprintf(string, size, "%s%01d:%02d:%02d.%03d", sign, hours, mins, secs, ms);
00256     }
00257 }
00258 
00259 static inline void frequencyToString (char* string, const int size, const double frequency)
00260 {
00261     if(frequency >= 1000.0)
00262     {
00263         snprintf(string, size, "%.2fkHz", frequency * 0.001);
00264     }
00265     else
00266     {
00267         snprintf(string, size, "%dHz", (int)(frequency + 0.5));
00268     }
00269 }

00282 void ScopeView::paint(CGRect const& rect) throw()
00283 {
00284     CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00285     CGContextClearRect(context, rect);
00286     
00287     CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[Background].getFloatArray());
00288     CGContextFillRect(context, rect);
00289     CGContextStrokePath(context);
00290             
00291     const int width = getWidth();
00292     if(width != previousWidth)
00293     {
00294         lock();
00295         resizedGUI();
00296         unlock();
00297         
00298         previousWidth = width;
00299     }
00300     else
00301         calculateBuffers();
00302     
00303     lock();
00304     
00305     if(minDrawBuffer.size() > 0 && maxDrawBuffer.size() > 0)
00306     {       
00307         if(isBipolar)
00308             paintBipolar(rect);
00309         else
00310             paintUnipolar(rect);
00311     }
00312     
00313     unlock();
00314 }

00316 void ScopeView::paintBipolar(CGRect const& rect) throw()
00317 {
00318     CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00319     
00320     CGContextSetLineWidth(context, 1.0f);
00321         
00322     const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00323     
00324     if(numChannels > 0)
00325     {
00326         const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00327         const int channelHeight = getHeight() / numChannels;
00328         const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00329         
00330         const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00331         
00332         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00333         {
00334             const float top = channelHeight * channel - 0.5f;
00335             const float middle = top + halfChannelHeight;
00336             const float bottom = top + channelHeight;
00337             
00338             // top line
00339             if(channel > 0)
00340             {
00341                 CGContextBeginPath(context);
00342                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, top + 1.f);
00343                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, getWidth()-1, top + 1.f);
00344                 CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[TopLine].getFloatArray());
00345                 CGContextStrokePath(context);
00346             }
00347             
00348             float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00349             float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00350                     
00351             // first scope line
00352             CGContextBeginPath(context);
00353             CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[Trace].getFloatArray());
00354             
00355             CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5f, middle - oldMaximum);
00356             CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, 0.5f, middle - oldMinimum);
00357             
00358             oldMinimum += 1.f;
00359             oldMaximum -= 1.f;
00360             
00361             for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++)
00362             {               
00363                 const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00364                 const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00365                 
00366                 float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
00367                 float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
00368                 
00369                 if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
00370                 {
00371                     if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
00372                     {
00373                         lineTop = 0.f;
00374                         lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
00375                     }
00376                     else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
00377                     {
00378                         lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
00379                         lineBottom = 0.f;
00380                     }
00381                 }
00382                 
00383                 lineTop = middle - lineTop;
00384                 lineBottom = middle - lineBottom;
00385                 
00386                 // the scope lines
00387                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, i + 0.5f, lineTop);
00388                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, i + 0.5f, lineBottom);
00389                 
00390                 oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
00391                 oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
00392             }
00393             
00394             CGContextStrokePath(context);
00395             
00396             paintXScale(rect, middle);
00397             paintYScale(rect, middle, top);
00398             paintYScale(rect, middle, bottom);
00399             paintChannelLabel(rect, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, top);
00400         }       
00401     }
00402 }

00495 void ScopeView::paintXScale(CGRect const& rect, const int y) throw()
00496 {
00497     CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00498     
00499     // zero line
00500     CGContextBeginPath(context);
00501     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, y + 0.5);
00502     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, getWidth()-1, y + 0.5);
00503     CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[ZeroLine].getFloatArray());
00504     CGContextStrokePath(context);
00505     
00506     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
00507     {       
00508         const double audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00509         const double samplesPerPixel = (double)getDisplayBufferSize() / audioBufferSize;
00510         
00511         const int markSpacing = markSpacingX;
00512         const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopX;
00513         
00514         unsigned int mark = 0;
00515         const int labelOffsetX = 3;
00516         const int labelOffsetY = markXHeight > 5 ? 4 : markXHeight + 1;
00517         
00518         CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeX, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
00519         CGContextSetRGBFillColor (context, 0, 1, 0, 1);
00520         CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, flipTransform);
00521         
00522         CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextX].getFloatArray());
00523         CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[LabelMarks].getFloatArray());
00524         
00525         CGContextBeginPath(context);
00526         for(int audioIndex = 0; audioIndex < audioBufferSize; audioIndex += markSpacing)
00527         {           
00528             const int x = audioIndex * samplesPerPixel + 0.5;
00529             
00530             if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))
00531             {
00532                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y + 0.5);
00533                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y - markXHeight * 1.5 + 0.5);
00534                 
00535                 if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
00536                    (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)
00537                 ) {
00538                     char label[256];
00539                     if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
00540                     {
00541                         timeToTimecodeString(label, sizeof(label), 
00542                                              (audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
00543                     }
00544                     else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
00545                     {
00546                         const double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
00547                         const double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
00548                         
00549                         frequencyToString(label, sizeof(label), binFreq);
00550                     }
00551                     else
00552                     {
00553                         snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%d", (int)(audioIndex + offsetSamples + 0.5));
00554                     }
00555                     
00556                     CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, 
00557                                              x + labelOffsetX + 0.5f, 
00558                                              y - labelOffsetY + 0.5f, 
00559                                              label, strlen(label)); 
00560                 }
00561             }
00562             else
00563             {
00564                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y + 0.5);
00565                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y - markXHeight + 0.5);
00566             }
00567             
00568             mark++;
00569         }   
00570         CGContextStrokePath(context);
00571     }
00572 }

00574 void ScopeView::paintYScale(CGRect const& rect, const int zero, const int maximum) throw()
00575 {
00576     if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYNone)
00577     {
00578         CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00579         
00580         const double markSpacing = markSpacingY;
00581         const int decimalPlaces = decimalPlacesY;
00582         const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopY;
00583         
00584         unsigned int mark = 0;
00585         const int labelOffsetX = markYWidth * 1.5 + 2;
00586         const int labelOffsetY = textSizeY / 2 + 2;
00587         
00588         const int height = zero-maximum;
00589         const double pixelFactor = (double)height / yMaximum;
00590         
00591         const double sign = height > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00592         
00593         CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeY, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
00594         CGContextSetRGBFillColor (context, 0, 1, 0, 1);
00595         CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, flipTransform);
00596 
00597         CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextY].getFloatArray());
00598         CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[LabelMarks].getFloatArray());
00599         
00600         CGContextBeginPath(context);
00601         for(double level = 0.0; level <= yMaximum; level += markSpacing)
00602         {
00603             const int y = zero - level * pixelFactor;
00604 
00605             if((((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)) && 
00606                (mark > 0) && 
00607                ((level+markSpacing) <= yMaximum))
00608             ) {
00609                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, y + 0.5);
00610                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, markYWidth * 1.5 + 0.5, y + 0.5);
00611                 
00612                 if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYMarks)
00613                 {
00614                     char label[256];
00615                     floatToString(label, sizeof(label), sign * level, decimalPlaces);
00616                     CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, labelOffsetX + 0.5f, y + labelOffsetY + 0.5f, label, strlen(label));  
00617                 }
00618             }
00619             else
00620             {
00621                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, y + 0.5);
00622                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, markYWidth + 0.5, y + 0.5);    
00623             }
00624             
00625             mark++;
00626         }
00627         CGContextStrokePath(context);
00628     }
00629 }

00631 void ScopeView::paintChannelLabel(CGRect const& rect, Text const& label, const int index, const int top) throw()
00632 {
00633     if(labelChannels)
00634     {
00635         CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00636         
00637         const int size = 256;
00638         char labelToPaint[size];
00639         
00640         if(label.length() == 0)
00641         {
00642             snprintf(labelToPaint, size, "Ch%d", index + channelLabelOffset);
00643         }
00644         else
00645         {
00646             snprintf(labelToPaint, size, (const char*)label, index + channelLabelOffset);
00647         }
00648         
00649         CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeChannel, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
00650         CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, flipTransform);
00651         CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextChannel].getFloatArray());
00652                 
00653         // measure the text
00654         CGContextSetTextDrawingMode(context, kCGTextInvisible);
00655         CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, 0, 0, labelToPaint, strlen(labelToPaint));
00656         CGPoint pt = CGContextGetTextPosition(context);
00657         CGContextSetTextDrawingMode(context, kCGTextFill);
00658         
00659         // draw it right aligned
00660         CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, 
00661                                  getWidth() - pt.x - 3 + 0.5f,
00662                                  top + textSizeChannel + 2 + 0.5f, 
00663                                  labelToPaint, strlen(labelToPaint));   
00664     }

00698         previousRadius = radius;
00699     }
00700     else
00701         calculateBuffers();
00702     
00703     lock();
00704     
00705     if(minDrawBuffer.size() > 0 && maxDrawBuffer.size() > 0)
00706     {       
00707         paintBipolar(rect);
00708     }
00709     
00710     unlock();
00711 }

00713 void RadialScopeView::paintBipolar(CGRect const& rect) throw()
00714 {
00715     CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00716     CGContextSetLineWidth(context, 1.0f);
00717     
00718     const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00719     
00720     if(numChannels > 0)
00721     {
00722         const float centreX = getCentreX() + 0.5f;
00723         const float centreY = getCentreY() + 0.5f;
00724         const float innerMargin = min(getLowerMargin(), (float)getRadius());
00725         const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00726         const int channelHeight = (getRadius() - innerMargin) / numChannels;
00727         const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00728         const int wrapOffset = bufferWrap * minDrawBuffer.size();
00729         
00730         const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00731         
00732         for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00733         {
00734             const float minRadius = channelHeight * channel - 0.5f + innerMargin;
00735             const float zeroRadius = minRadius + halfChannelHeight;
00736             const float maxRadius = minRadius + channelHeight;
00737             
00738             // outer            
00739             CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[TopLine].getFloatArray());
00740             CGContextStrokeEllipseInRect(context, CGRectMake(getCentreX()-maxRadius, getCentreY()-maxRadius, maxRadius*2, maxRadius*2));
00741             
00742             paintXScale(rect, zeroRadius);
00743 //          paintYScale(rect, zeroRadius, minRadius);
00744 //          paintYScale(rect, zeroRadius, maxRadius);
00745 //          paintChannelLabel(rect, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, minRadius);
00746             
00747 //          float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00748 //          float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00749             float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, 0 + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00750             float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, 0 + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00751 
00752             
00753             const double delta = getDelta() * sine.size();
00754             double position = delta;
00755             
00756             // first scope line
00757             CGContextBeginPath(context);
00758             CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[Trace].getFloatArray());
00759             CGContextMoveToPoint(context, centreX, centreY - zeroRadius - oldMaximum);
00760             CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, centreX, centreY - zeroRadius - oldMinimum);
00761             
00762             oldMinimum += 1.f;
00763             oldMaximum -= 1.f;
00764             
00765             for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++, position += delta)
00766             {               
00767 //              const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00768 //              const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00769                 const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, i + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00770                 const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, i + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00771                 
00772                 float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
00773                 float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
00774                 
00775                 if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
00776                 {
00777                     if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
00778                     {
00779                         lineTop = 0.f;
00780                         lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
00781                     }
00782                     else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
00783                     {
00784                         lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
00785                         lineBottom = 0.f;
00786                     }
00787                 }
00788                 
00789                 lineTop = zeroRadius - lineTop;
00790                 lineBottom = zeroRadius - lineBottom;
00791                 
00792                 // the scope lines
00793                 const float sinAngle = sine.getSampleUnchecked(position);
00794                 const float cosAngle = cosine.getSampleUnchecked(position);
00795                 
00796                 const float startX = sinAngle * lineBottom;
00797                 const float startY = cosAngle * lineBottom;
00798                 const float endX = sinAngle * lineTop;
00799                 const float endY = cosAngle * lineTop;
00800                 
00801                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, centreX + startX, centreY - startY);
00802                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, centreX + endX, centreY - endY);
00803                 
00804                 oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
00805                 oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
00806             }
00807             
00808             CGContextStrokePath(context);
00809             
00810             if(innerMargin > 0)
00811             {           
00812                 // inner                
00813                 CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[TopLine].getFloatArray());
00814                 CGContextStrokeEllipseInRect(context, CGRectMake(getCentreX()-innerMargin, 
00815                                                                  getCentreY()-innerMargin, 
00816                                                                  innerMargin*2, 
00817                                                                  innerMargin*2));
00818             }
00819         }       
00820     }
00821 }

00823 void RadialScopeView::paintXScale(CGRect const& rect, const int radius) throw()
00824 {
00825     CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00826     CGContextSetLineWidth(context, 1.0f);
00827     
00828     const int diameter = radius*2;
00829     const float centreX = getCentreX() + 0.5f;
00830     const float centreY = getCentreY() + 0.5f;
00831     
00832     // zero line    
00833     CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[ZeroLine].getFloatArray());
00834     CGContextStrokeEllipseInRect(context, CGRectMake(centreX-radius, centreY-radius, diameter, diameter));
00835     
00836     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
00837     {       
00838 //      ugen_assert(bufferWrap == 0.0); // need to upate this function if the waveform is rotated...
00839         
00840         const double audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00841         const double radiansPerSample = twopi / audioBufferSize;
00842         const double radiansOffset = bufferWrap * twopi;
00843         
00844         const int markSpacing = markSpacingX;
00845         const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopX;
00846         
00847         unsigned int mark = 0;
00848 //      const int labelOffsetX = 3;
00849 //      const int labelOffsetY = markXHeight > 5 ? 4 : markXHeight + 1;
00850         
00851         CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeX, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
00852         CGContextSetRGBFillColor (context, 0, 1, 0, 1);
00853         
00854         CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextX].getFloatArray());
00855         CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[LabelMarks].getFloatArray());
00856         
00857         CGContextBeginPath(context);
00858         for(int audioIndex = 0; audioIndex < audioBufferSize; audioIndex += markSpacing)
00859         {           
00860             const float angle = audioIndex * radiansPerSample - radiansOffset;
00861             const float sinAngle = sin(angle);
00862             const float cosAngle = cos(angle);
00863             const float startX = sinAngle * radius;
00864             const float startY = cosAngle * radius;
00865             
00866             if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))
00867             {
00868                 const float end = radius + markXHeight * 1.5;
00869                 const float endX = sinAngle * end;
00870                 const float endY = cosAngle * end;
00871                 
00872                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, centreX+startX, centreY-startY);
00873                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, centreX+endX, centreY-endY);
00874                 
00875                 if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
00876                    (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)
00877                    ) {
00878                     char label[256];
00879                     if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
00880                     {
00881                         timeToTimecodeString(label, sizeof(label), 
00882                                              (audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
00883                     }
00884                     else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
00885                     {
00886                         const double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
00887                         const double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
00888                         
00889                         frequencyToString(label, sizeof(label), binFreq);
00890                     }
00891                     else
00892                     {
00893                         snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%d", (int)(audioIndex + offsetSamples + 0.5));
00894                     }
00895                     
00896                     const double rotation = pi2-angle;
00897                     //if(angle > pi) rotation += pi;                    
00898                     CGAffineTransform transform = CGAffineTransformRotate(flipTransform, rotation);
00899                     CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, transform);
00900                     CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, 
00901                                              centreX+endX*1.01, 
00902                                              centreY-endY*1.01, 
00903                                              label, strlen(label)); 
00904                 }
00905             }
00906             else
00907             {
00908                 const float end = radius + markXHeight;
00909                 const float endX = sinAngle * end;
00910                 const float endY = cosAngle * end;
00911                 
00912                 CGContextMoveToPoint(context, centreX+startX, centreY-startY);
00913                 CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, centreX+endX, centreY-endY);
00914             }
00915             
00916             mark++;
00917         }   
00918         CGContextStrokePath(context);
00919     }
00920     
00921 }
